user_stories.want: view and update my profile settings offline
user_stories.so_that: my preferences persist seamlessly across network drops

user_stories.want: navigate all profile controls with TalkBack

functional_requirements.title: Offline Preference Persistence
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall persist profile settings to local DataStore immediately upon modification.

functional_requirements.title: TalkBack Accessibility Support
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall expose screen reader semantics and labels on all profile interactive elements.

acceptance_criteria.given: user has saved local profile data

acceptance_criteria.then: preference is updated locally in DataStore and UI reflects change
